items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: He could make a violin talk.

ctx.x: He had no piano. I'll tell you where they used piano in them days. Body. Well we had cut body now. Didn't probably say they couldn't hear. But when he worked to Lewis the man he had a son named Joe. Remember this Joe? I said what Joe's last name is. He just thought about his son. He was a little bit of a little bit of a little bit of a little bit of a little bit of a little He could make a violin talk. He was a little bit of a jazz. He didn't call it jazz. He called it radio music. Joe Welch. Yeah Joe Welch.…
What instrument? What instrument he played?
